test_title: SSC CGL Tier 2 English Previous Paper 2 (Held On: 3 Feb 2022)
subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate option for the given group of words.**

A mass of snow, ice and rocks falling rapidly down a mountainside.
solution: The correct answer is '**Avalanche**'. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The most appropriate word for the given group of words is '**Avalanche**'. • It means** 'a very large amount of snow that slides quickly down the side of a mountain**'. ((पहाड़ों पर से) गिरती हुई बर्फ़ की चट्टानें; हिम-स्‍खलन) • *Example: He has been swept away in an **avalanche**.* **Correct Answer:__** *Avalanche.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • Let's look at the **meaning** of other words: • **Blizzard**: a very bad storm with strong winds and a lot of snow. (बर्फ़ानी तूफ़ान, हिम-झंझावात) • **Glacier**: a mass of ice that moves slowly down a valley. (घाटी में धीरे-धीरे चलती हिमराशि; हिमनदी) • **Typhoon**: a violent tropical storm with very strong winds. (प्रचंड तूफ़ान; टाइफ़ून) b8:Tbc0, The correct answer is '**Affix**'.
